ruleRefs.description: Each application receives its application number from the platform number sequence when it is recorded, and that number never changes.
Every newly recorded application starts in the screening stage.
A new application can be recorded only for a job position whose status is open.
A candidate may have at most one active application, in screening, interview or offer, for the same job position at a time.
Only a recruiter records applications, moves an application from screening to interview, and rejects applications with a reason; the offer and hired stages are not set by the recruiter.
Only the hiring manager assigned to the application's job position may move an application from interview to offer or from offer to hired.
An application can be rejected only from screening, interview or offer, and only when a non-empty rejection reason is given; the rejection time and the stage at rejection are recorded with it.
An application can be moved to hired only while its job position is open and still has at least one remaining opening.
A job position is filled, and must be closed, once the number of its applications in the hired stage is equal to or greater than its headcount; a position that is not filled stays open.
A candidate can be registered only with an e-mail address, which is linked to the candidate as an e-mail contact channel.
A candidate can be registered only when the recruiter records the source channel through which the candidate reached the organization.
